/* wire/codec.h - the module wire::codec, ported to C (CodeCoreMorph, D-75). */
#ifndef WIRE_CODEC_H
#define WIRE_CODEC_H

#endif /* WIRE_CODEC_H */

/* The module wire::codec, ported to C. */
#include "wire/codec.h"

# The Rust items this port moved to C, and the C that took them over (CodeCoreMorph, D-75).
# One entry per public item of a ported module:
#
#   [[symbol]]
#   rust = "stats::stats::mean"
#   c = "stats_mean"          # or a list of names
#   note = "..."              # optional: what C couldn't keep, or why c is empty
edits.replace:
# The Rust items this port moved to C, and the C that took them over (CodeCoreMorph, D-75).
# One entry per public item of a ported module:
#
#   [[symbol]]
#   rust = "stats::stats::mean"
#   c = "stats_mean"          # or a list of names
#   note = "..."              # optional: what C couldn't keep, or why c is empty

[[symbol]]
rust = "wire::codec::Encode"
c = ["wire_buf", "wire_buf_push", "wire_buf_free"]
note = "a trait, which C has not: each implementation is two functions of its type, one appending to a wire_buf (wire_u16_encode, wire_header_encode) and one returning the length (wire_u16_encoded_len)"

[[symbol]]
rust = "wire::codec::Decode"
c = ["wire_input", "wire_decode_error"]
note = "a trait, which C has not: each implementation is a function of its type that takes its bytes off a wire_input and returns 0, or -1 with the error (wire_u16_decode, wire_header_decode)"

[[symbol]]
rust = "wire::codec::DecodeError"
c = ["wire_decode_error", "wire_decode_error_kind", "wire_decode_error_display"]
note = "a kind and the variant's fields; Display is wire_decode_error_display"

[[symbol]]
rust = "wire::codec::DecodeError::Short"
c = "wire_decode_error_kind::WIRE_DECODE_SHORT"

[[symbol]]
rust = "wire::codec::DecodeError::BadTag"
c = ["wire_decode_error_kind::WIRE_DECODE_BAD_TAG", "wire_decode_error::byte"]

[[symbol]]
rust = "wire::codec::DecodeError::BadBool"
c = ["wire_decode_error_kind::WIRE_DECODE_BAD_BOOL", "wire_decode_error::byte"]

[[symbol]]
rust = "wire::codec::DecodeError::BadCrc"
c = ["wire_decode_error_kind::WIRE_DECODE_BAD_CRC", "wire_decode_error::expected", "wire_decode_error::found"]

arguments.summary: Ported wire::codec to C (c/src/codec.c, c/include/wire/codec.h); src/codec.rs is now a façade calling it through bindgen's sys, its tests unchanged; mapped its public items.
review_notes: codec's sys is pub(crate): msg's façade frees the C buffers through it.
